description: Frontend (D:\Projects\Finnova\Finnova-UI, current branch 'main'): permission model + service (interface/real/mock/toggle) + barrels, PermissionsContext wired into the App provider tree, useScreenPermissions hook, gate Add/Edit/Delete/Save across master pages, grids, and forms, fix login email->userName, and Vitest tests. Depends on FEAT-001 for the wire contract: UI field names MUST match the backend camelCase JSON { isAdmin, programs:[{ programName, canAdd, canModify, canQuery, canDelete }] }.
steps: Create D:\Projects\Finnova\Finnova-UI\src\models\permission.model.ts: interface ScreenPermission { programName; canAdd; canModify; canQuery; canDelete } and interface MyPermissions { isAdmin: boolean; programs: ScreenPermission[] }. Add `export * from './permission.model';` to src\models\index.ts.

Add the permission service: src\services\interfaces\permission.interface.ts (IPermissionService.getMyPermissions(): Promise<MyPermissions>), src\services\real\permission.real.ts (api.get<MyPermissions>('/auth/me/permissions') -> response.data), src\services\mock\permission.mock.ts (isAdmin:false, a couple programs mixed flags e.g. LookupMaster all true, CourtMaster canQuery only), src\services\permission.service.ts (toggle on import.meta.env.VITE_USE_MOCK_API). Update barrels src\services\index.ts and src\services\interfaces\index.ts.

Create src\context\PermissionsContext.tsx: on useAuth().isAuthenticated true, fetch permissionService.getMyPermissions() in useEffect; store MyPermissions|null + loading; clear on logout/not-authenticated; refetch on login. Expose usePermissions() -> { permissions, loading, can(programName, action:'add'|'modify'|'query'|'delete'): boolean } where can returns true if isAdmin, else the program entry's matching flag, else false (absent program => false). Wire the provider INSIDE AuthProvider in src\App.tsx (ThemeProvider>AuthProvider>PermissionsProvider>NotificationProvider>BrowserRouter).
Create src\hooks\useScreenPermissions.ts: useScreenPermissions(programName) -> { canAdd, canModify, canQuery, canDelete } via usePermissions().can(programName, ...). Admin => all true through can.

Gate pages/grids/forms using the ProgramName map (LookupMaster->LookupMaster, CourtMaster->CourtMaster, DcnMaster->DocumentNumberControl, EntityMaster->EntityMaster, NationalityMaster->NationalityMaster, OrgHierarchyMaster->OrganizationHierarchy, LocationMaster->LocationMaster, UserManagementMaster->UserManagement). In each master page: const { canAdd, canModify, canDelete } = useScreenPermissions('<ProgramName>'); disable Add via disabled={<existing> || !canAdd} (AND with existing gating like !canQuery); pass canModify/canDelete into the feature grid component (src\components\<feature>\*Grid.tsx) and apply disabled on its Edit/Delete icon buttons (preserve existing isSystemLocked disabling). In each *Form.tsx: effective = isEdit ? canModify : canAdd; Save button disabled={submitting || !effective}. Minimal consistent edits; do NOT restructure pages. Pages: LookupMaster/Form, CourtMaster/Form, DcnMaster/Form, EntityMaster/Form, NationalityMaster/Form, OrgHierarchyMaster/Form, LocationMaster/Form, UserManagementMaster/Form.

Fix the login contract email->userName: src\models\auth.model.ts LoginRequest -> { userName: string; password: string }; src\services\mock\auth.mock.ts keys off userName; src\pages\Login.tsx state+field label/value, authService.login({ userName, password }) call, and the mock-user fallback.

Add Vitest tests: unit-test usePermissions/can() (admin true for any; non-admin flag value; absent program false); permission service test (mock returns fixture; real calls '/auth/me/permissions' with mocked axios); extend src\pages\LookupMaster.test.tsx (Add disabled when canAdd false, enabled when true - provide a PermissionsContext or mock usePermissions); add a LookupForm Save-disabled-without-permission test. Mirror existing *.test.tsx (mock services barrel, MemoryRouter).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` (cwd D:\Projects\Finnova\Finnova-UI) succeeds with no type errors.
`npm test -- --run` passes including the new permission unit/service tests and the LookupMaster/LookupForm gating tests.
UI ScreenPermission/MyPermissions field names exactly match the backend camelCase JSON (programName, canAdd, canModify, canQuery, canDelete, isAdmin, programs).

Add is disabled when canAdd is false; Edit/Delete icon buttons disabled when canModify/canDelete false; Save disabled when the effective create/edit permission is false; existing gating (e.g. canQuery, isSystemLocked) is preserved.
Login sends { userName, password } and compiles end-to-end.
findings: DONE. Verification green on branch main (D:\Projects\Finnova\Finnova-UI): `npm run build` (tsc -b && vite build) succeeds with no type errors; `npm test -- --run` = 184 passed / 0 failed across 31 test files (incl. 6 new permission tests). NOTHING committed in either repo. WIRE CONTRACT PARITY: UI MyPermissions/ScreenPermission field names match FEAT-001 backend camelCase exactly { isAdmin, programs:[{ programName, canAdd, canModify, canQuery, canDelete }] }. NEW FILES: src/models/permission.model.ts (ScreenPermission, MyPermissions); src/services/interfaces/permission.interface.ts (IPermissionService.getMyPermissions); src/services/real/permission.real.ts (api.get('/auth/me/permissions') -> response.data, relative to shared axios base which already carries the gateway UA prefix per FEAT-001); src/services/mock/permission.mock.ts (isAdmin:false, LookupMaster all-true, CourtMaster query-only; absent screens => no access); src/services/permission.service.ts (toggles on import.meta.env.VITE_USE_MOCK_API); src/context/PermissionsContext.tsx (PermissionsProvider + usePermissions; fetches on isAuthenticated true, clears on logout, refetches on login; can(programName, action) => isAdmin bypass true, else per-program flag, else false for absent program); src/hooks/useScreenPermissions.ts (returns {canAdd,canModify,canQuery,canDelete} for a ProgramName). BARRELS updated: models/index.ts, services/index.ts, services/interfaces/index.ts. PROVIDER TREE in src/App.tsx: ThemeProvider > AuthProvider > PermissionsProvider > NotificationProvider > BrowserRouter (PermissionsProvider nested INSIDE AuthProvider so it can read useAuth). GATING applied (existing gating like !canQuery and isSystemLocked PRESERVED and AND-ed with the new flags): LookupMaster (Add: !canQuery||!canAdd; LookupGrid Edit/Delete icon buttons disabled by locked||!canModify / locked||!canDelete), LookupForm (Save: submitting||!(isEdit?canModify:canAdd)); CourtMaster (Add !canAdd; CourtGrid Edit + Activate/Deactivate gated by canModify), CourtForm (Save by canSave); DcnMaster->ProgramName 'DocumentNumberControl' (Add !canAdd; DcnGrid Edit/toggle by canModify), DcnForm (Save by canSave); EntityMaster (Add !canAdd; EntityGrid Edit/toggle by canModify), EntityForm (Save by canSave); NationalityMaster (Add !canAdd; NationalityGrid Edit by canModify), NationalityForm (Save by canSave); OrgHierarchyMaster->ProgramName 'OrganizationHierarchy' (Add !canAdd; OrgHierarchyGrid AND OrgHierarchyTree Edit by canModify, Delete by canDelete), OrgHierarchyForm (Save by canSave); LocationMaster->ProgramName 'LocationMaster' (Add-root !canAdd; LocationTreeTable add-child by canAdd, Delete by canDelete), LocationForm (Add Location by !isValid||submitting||!canAdd; add-only screen so canAdd gates); UserManagementMaster->ProgramName 'UserManagement' (New User !canAdd, grid Modify !canModify, Query !canQuery), UserManagementForm computes canSave = mode==='Create' ? canAdd : canModify and passes it to UserManagementWizard which disables the final Save/Update via readOnly||submitting||!canSave (Query stays read-only). PROGRAMNAME MAP used (UI page -> screen key): LookupMaster->LookupMaster, CourtMaster->CourtMaster, DcnMaster->DocumentNumberControl, EntityMaster->EntityMaster, NationalityMaster->NationalityMaster, OrgHierarchyMaster->OrganizationHierarchy, LocationMaster->LocationMaster, UserManagementMaster->UserManagement. LOGIN CONTRACT fixed email->userName: models/auth.model.ts LoginRequest { userName; password }, services/mock/auth.mock.ts keys MOCK_USERS off userName (admin/manager/analyst) and the dev fallback derives email from userName, pages/Login.tsx uses userName state + 'User Name' text field (autoComplete username) + authService.login({ userName, password }) + mock-user fallback email `${userName}@finnova.com`. TESTS added: src/context/PermissionsContext.test.tsx (admin => true for any program/action; non-admin => matching flag value; absent program => false; not-authenticated => cleared, no fetch), src/services/permission.service.test.ts (real GETs '/auth/me/permissions' on shared api and returns data; mock returns the camelCase fixture), extended src/pages/LookupMaster.test.tsx (Add disabled when canAdd false / enabled when true; Edit+Delete disabled when canModify/canDelete false - via mocking ../hooks/useScreenPermissions), extended src/pages/LookupForm.test.tsx (Save disabled in add mode when canAdd false). INTEGRATION NOTES FOR MERGE: (1) The real endpoint is GET /api/auth/me/permissions on the UA host behind the gateway (FEAT-001); the UI calls it as '/auth/me/permissions' relative to the shared axios base (src/services/api.ts) which already includes the gateway UA prefix - no api.ts change was needed. (2) Default dev experience uses the mock (VITE_USE_MOCK_API=true) which returns a non-admin fixture, so non-permitted controls are disabled by default; set isAdmin or add programs in permission.mock.ts to exercise enabled states, or set VITE_USE_MOCK_API=false to hit the real UA endpoint. (3) Permissions are fetched once per authenticated session and cached in context; on logout they clear and on next login they refetch. (4) Existing page/form/grid tests that render permission-gated components mock ../hooks/useScreenPermissions (default all-true) to preserve prior behaviour - any new master-page test that renders a gated page must do the same or wrap in PermissionsProvider. (5) The vite build emits a pre-existing chunk-size (>500kB) warning unrelated to this feature.
